name: InitIopCommandChannels
evidence: binds the two RPC channels D_0027B4C8 and D_0027B4F0, points the command buffers D_0025C360/D_0025C370/D_0025C378 at their storage, clears the bookkeeping and sends command 0 with the address of D_00260DC0 (file_1B7968.cpp's start-up calls it first)

name: PollIopCommands
evidence: runs the pending reply callbacks (queued entries, the single bank-load callback), sends the buffered commands when idle and returns 1 while a reply or bank load is still outstanding (callers loop on it until 0)

name: IsIopReplyReady
evidence: polls the RPC, then returns 1 when no reply buffer is armed or when the armed buffer's first word and the word after its count are both 0xFFFFFFFF (clearing the buffer), else 0

name: ArmIopReplyBuffer
evidence: stores the reply buffer pointer in D_0025C340 and its word count in D_0025C344 and zeroes the first word and the word after the count, which IsIopReplyReady then waits to see filled

name: LoadSoundBankAtLocation
evidence: fails with a message while another load is pending, otherwise sends command 3 with a location word and waits for the reply word, which file_1B7968.cpp keeps as the bank handle

name: StartSoundBankLoad
evidence: the asynchronous twin of LoadSoundBankAtLocation: stores the callback and its argument in D_0025C390, sets D_0025C388.busy and sends command 3; PollIopCommands calls the callback with the reply (file_1B7968.cpp passes func_001BEAC8)

name: NotifyIopBanksChanged
evidence: queues IOP command 8 without data; EnsureSoundBankLoaded calls it after it loads a bank with LoadSoundBankAtLocation and after it clears an unloaded bank's handle, StoreStagedBankHandle when a staged bank's handle arrives

name: UnloadSoundBank
evidence: sends command 6 with a bank handle; file_1B7968.cpp calls it with the bank handle after stopping the voice started from that bank

name: SetIopVolumeChannel
evidence: sends command 9 with a channel number and a value; callers pass values scaled by 1024 (the master channel 8 from func_001C05D0, channels 0 to 3 from func_001C0600)

name: GetIopVolumeChannel
evidence: sends command 10 with a channel number and returns the reply; func_0018E940 saves channels 2 and 8 with it and func_0018EAA0 restores them with SetIopVolumeChannel

name: SetIopSoundOptionFlag
evidence: queues IOP command 11 with one word; its only caller func_001C0790 passes whether the save data's option bit 0x40 (g_saveData->f19EC) is set (ResetVolumeChannelFactors, ResumeAtSavedLevel, ActivatePauseMenuSelection)

name: QueueIopCommandD
evidence: queues IOP command 0xD with two words (8 bytes); the sound system's start-up sends it with 0 and 1

name: QueueIopChannelConfig
evidence: queues IOP command 0x4E with three words (a channel index and two values); the sound system's start-up sends it for channels 0 to 3 with 0x2F and 0 or 0x18

name: StartSoundVoice
evidence: sends command 0x11 with six words (bank handle, sound index and parameters) and returns the voice handle that StopSoundVoice, IsVoiceBusy and RequestVoiceCallback later take

name: StopSoundVoice
evidence: sends command 0x15 with a voice handle; callers use it to stop the voice (or to cut it at once when the fade time is 0)

name: PauseIopVoice
evidence: queues IOP command 0x13 with a voice handle; the text panel, the pause and warp menus (through func_001BEA28, func_001BED48) and the camera's sounds call it on opening, and ResumeIopVoice on closing

name: ResumeIopVoice
evidence: queues IOP command 0x14 with a voice handle: the counterpart of PauseIopVoice, called by the same panels and menus (func_001BEA50, func_001BED70) when they close

name: SuspendIopVoices
evidence: queues command 0x16 with a voice mask; func_0018E940 passes 0xFFFFFFFF before it saves the volume channels and syncs the disc, and func_0018EAA0 undoes it with ResumeIopVoices

name: ResumeIopVoices
evidence: queues command 0x17 with a voice mask; func_0018EAA0 passes 0xFFFFFFFF last, after restoring the volume channels SuspendIopVoices' caller saved

name: IsVoiceBusy
evidence: sends command 0x19 with a voice handle and returns the reply, which file_1B7968.cpp loops on after StopSoundVoice until it reads 0

name: RequestVoiceCallback
evidence: queues command 0x19 with a voice handle plus a callback function and a 64-bit argument for PollIopCommands to call (file_1B7968.cpp passes func_001BFFC8 and a record address)

name: TestSoundInBank
evidence: sends IOP command 0x1A with a bank handle and a sound's argument and returns the reply; EnsureSoundBankLoaded marks each of the bank's sound entries available when it is nonzero

name: SetVoiceVolumePan
evidence: sends command 0x1B with a voice handle and two words; ApplySoundRecordVolumePan passes the record's volume times 1024 and a pan angle, and the stream voice reset passes 0, 0

name: GetSoundPitchBase
evidence: sends command 0x1C with a bank handle and a sound index and returns the reply, which func_001BF7F8 adds to its scaled pitch term

name: SetVoicePitch
evidence: sends command 0x1E with a voice handle and a value func_001BF7F8 clamps to -0x8000..0x7FFF

name: FadeOutSoundVoice
evidence: queues IOP command 0x22 with a voice handle and three words; StopSoundRecord sends it with -4, the fade time times 0.24 and 2 when the fade time is not 0 (StopSoundVoice otherwise)

name: SetVoiceParam
evidence: sends command 0x29 with a voice, a parameter index and a value; func_001C0C08 calls it when the cached D_006053E0[index] changes

name: GetVoiceParam
evidence: sends command 0x28 with a voice and a parameter index and returns the reply, which func_001C0C68 stores in D_006053E0[index]

name: SendIopSoundLevel
evidence: queues IOP command 0x27 with one word; every caller passes a sound level plus 0x14 (ClearSoundLevels, ReleaseSoundLevel, InitSoundSystem, UpdateSoundEmitters)

name: SendIopCommandAndWait
evidence: copies the argument bytes into D_0025C400, waits for earlier traffic, sends the command id with that buffer over the RPC channel and returns the reply word

name: QueueIopCommand
evidence: appends a command (id, length, bytes, plus a callback word and a 64-bit argument) to the current command buffer, polling and waiting while the buffer is full (it prints a buffer-full message); a zero-length command with nothing queued is sent at once

name: CommitQueuedIopCommand
evidence: adds one to the command count of the current buffer D_0025C360[D_0025C380] and polls with PollIopCommands (the last step of QueueIopCommand)

name: FlushIopCommandBuffer
evidence: sends the current command buffer as command 0x4D together with its callback table, then switches D_0025C380 to the other buffer and empties it

name: EnableIopDiscAccess
evidence: sends command 0x2A with four words (file_1B7968.cpp passes 1, 0x2000, 1, 1 at start-up) and keeps the reply in D_0025C34C, which StartDiscRead, SyncDiscRead and GetDiscReadError test to choose the IOP path

name: StopAllIopSounds
evidence: queues IOP command 0x34 without data; StopAllSoundsAndWait and StartMovieStream call it before waiting on command 0x36

name: StartStreamedVoice
evidence: packs seven words (location, two packed halfword pairs and three flags) and sends command 0x2C, returning the voice handle; func_001BE728 and func_001BE5F8 keep it in D_0027472C

name: QueryIopStreamVoice
evidence: queues IOP command 0x2E with one word; CheckStreamVoicePending sends it for g_streamVoice while no reply is pending

name: RequestStreamCallback
evidence: queues command 0x4F with a stream handle plus a callback function and 64-bit argument (func_001BE5F8 passes func_001BE5D8 and the handle)

name: WaitForIopSoundStop
evidence: sends IOP command 0x36 with one word and waits; StopAllSoundsAndWait and StartMovieStream pass 1 after StopAllIopSounds and draining PollIopCommands, before SyncDiscRead

name: StartDiscRead
evidence: with D_0025C34C zero it forwards to func_00203B18, otherwise it checks the drive is idle, sets busy in the shared packet and sends command 0x38 with three words; disc_access.cpp's read loops call it and repeat until it returns 1

name: SyncDiscRead
evidence: with D_0025C34C zero it forwards to func_002032C8, otherwise it polls until the shared packet's busy word clears (argument 1 only tests and returns 1 when still busy); callers loop it after StartDiscRead

name: CloseDiscStream
evidence: without IOP disc access calls StopDiscRead, else queues IOP command 0x37 and returns 1; CloseBufferedStream calls it

name: GetDiscReadError
evidence: with D_0025C34C zero it forwards to func_00203D90, otherwise returns the word at +0x10 of the shared packet D_00260DC0; file_137290.cpp and disc_access.cpp read it after SyncDiscRead as the read's error

name: SetIopChannelValue
evidence: sends command 0xE with a channel number and a value; PushIopChannel2Setting, PopIopChannel2Setting and SetIopChannel2Setting call it for channel 2 with a table entry

name: SetIopChannelValuePair
evidence: sends command 0xF with a channel number and two words; the channel 2 setting functions pass the same value twice

name: QueueIopCommand51
evidence: queues IOP command 0x51 with two words (8 bytes); the sound system's start-up sends it with 2 and 4 last

name: OpenIopRing
evidence: sends command 0x3B with five words (movie_player passes 0x6000, 0x400, 0, 2, 2) and returns the reply, which becomes the ring address handed to func_0018E678

name: ResetIopRing
evidence: sends command 0x3D and waits; func_0018EA48 calls it when its ring is active, then marks it and resets its two ring buffers

name: StopIopMovieStream
evidence: sends IOP command 0x3C without data and waits (SendIopCommandAndWait); StopMovieStream calls it

name: UpdateIopMovieStream
evidence: sends IOP command 0x3E with five words and waits; UpdateMovieStream calls it with its two stream words

name: GetIopRingPosition
evidence: sends command 0x40 and returns the reply; func_0018E838 masks it with 0xFFFFFF to find the IOP's position in its ring

name: ConvertSpeedToPitchOffset
evidence: returns its argument times 1524 / 741; ComputeSoundRecordDoppler converts the bodies' relative speed with it into the pitch offset at +0x60
